contract.goal: A playable, self-contained arcade game in one index.html: a real game loop and input, a visible win or lose state, and an in-page restart, with scripts that parse and no network assets.

deliverables.description: The finished game, with its CSS and JavaScript inline

criteria.text: index.html is a complete, substantial game page whose HTML is well formed and whose inline scripts parse
It runs a game loop and handles player input
A round reaches a visible win or lose state, and the player can restart in the page
It loads no network assets: no external scripts, stylesheets, fonts, images or sounds
It actually plays: input moves the player, collisions change the score or state, a round can end, and restart starts a fresh round without console errors

judge.rubric: Played or traced through its source, does input move the player, do collisions change score or state, can a round reach its end state, and does restart begin a clean round with no errors?

criteria.text: It looks deliberate: a consistent palette, readable game objects, a HUD showing score, lives or time, and at least one feedback effect

judge.rubric: Does the game use a consistent palette, readable shapes, a clear HUD, and at least one feedback effect such as a hit flash, shake or particles?
